description: Config-driven rule pack measuring enablement, usage, response validity/relevance and performance posture for Power BI Copilot and Microsoft Fabric data agents. Designed so that AI query generation is narrowly scoped and grounded rather than broad-scanning an unconstrained schema.

extensionPoints.note: Drop additional rule files matching the same rule schema into rules/custom/. The harness merges them by id; a custom rule with an existing id overrides the built-in rule of that id.

blocker.description: AI features cannot function or cannot be trusted at all until fixed. A failed blocker caps overall maturity at Not Ready.

critical.description: Materially wrong answers, security exposure, or severe cost/latency. Fix before broad rollout.

high.description: Frequent ambiguity, degraded relevance, or avoidable capacity burn.

medium.description: Noticeable quality or efficiency loss; fix during hardening.

low.description: Polish and consistency; improves long-run maintainability.

partial.description: Partially met, e.g. applied to some models/agents but not all in scope.

na.description: Out of scope for this estate; removed from both numerator and denominator.

unknown.description: Not yet assessed. Scored as fail but reported separately as assessment debt.

maturityLevels.name: Not Ready
maturityLevels.meaning: Do not expose Copilot or data agents to business users. Blocking enablement or trust gaps present.

maturityLevels.name: Foundational
maturityLevels.meaning: Enabled and technically working, but answers are unreliable and cost/latency is uncontrolled. Pilot with a closed group only.

maturityLevels.name: Operational
maturityLevels.meaning: Scoped and governed for a defined question set. Suitable for a supervised department rollout.

maturityLevels.name: Optimized
maturityLevels.meaning: Grounded, narrow, measured. Answers are repeatable and query cost is bounded. Suitable for broad rollout.

maturityLevels.name: AI-Ready
maturityLevels.meaning: Continuously evaluated against a golden question set with regression gates in the release pipeline.

scoring.areaScore: 100 * sum(ruleScore in area) / sum(maxRuleScore in area, excluding na)
scoring.overallScore: sum(areaScore * areaWeight) / sum(areaWeight of areas with at least one applicable rule)
scoring.gate: If any rule with severity=blocker has result=fail or unknown, overallMaturity is forced to level 0 regardless of numeric score. The numeric score is still reported.
